findings.summary: Free-form policy reasons can leak customer text through durable policy data and listPolicies responses.
findings.details: The S13-T03 task requires the operations seam to let operators diagnose and stop subsystems without viewing customer text/prompts. setPolicyInternal accepts an unrestricted reason, nextOperationPolicy stores it, operationPolicyRecord serializes it into durable policy dataJson, and toPolicyReturn returns it to callers. The focused test even uses a reason containing a customer prompt canary and only asserts the audit event omits it, leaving the durable policy row and list/mutation response as leak paths. Redact or constrain returned/persisted reason text, or split private operator rationale from a safe public reason before this can be considered safe.
